newsitem.title: UK: Royal & Sun to buy portfolio from Argentaria.
newsitem.headline: Royal & Sun to buy portfolio from Argentaria.

text.p: Royal & Sun Alliance Insurance Group Plc said on Tuesday it agreed to buy the insurance portfolio of one of Corporacion Bancaria de Espana SA's (Argentaria's) units for not more than 20 million stg.
The British insurance group said it would purchase the portfolio of business produced by the agents of Hercules Hispano, Argentaria's insurance unit.
Premium income of the business amounted to 90 million stg in 1996, Royal & Sun said in a statement.
Royal & Sun's existing general insurance operations in Spain, including the Regal direct motor business, generate a premium income of over 120 million stg.
The company also said it agreed to enter into a six-year pact with Argentaria to distribute non-life insurance products.
The two deals were expected to take effect in mid-1997.
"Royal & Sun Alliance's capacity for multi-channel distribution in Spain, and hence the earnings potential of our operations there, will be significantly strengthened," the company said.
